_about: Public-domain Edward Garbett (1817-1887), evangelical vicar of Christ Church, Surbiton, editor of the Record and Bampton lecturer, for the Word Hoard: The Soul's Life (1860), The Divine Plan of Revelation (1864), The Family Prayer Book (1864), Religion in Daily Life (1865), God's Word Written (1866), The Dogmatic Faith (Bampton Lectures, 1867), The Obligations of Truth in Religious Controversy (1874) and Morning, Noon and Night (1880). Edward Lacy Garbett, the architect, is another man. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 66 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
